description: The conversational eval (export/README.md "Chat export"): whole dialogue records reserved from training. pie.export.build() moves them out of train_records into eval_dialogue_records; they make no task and no text view, only the chat/eval.jsonl conversations (pie_dialogue and every English-input mode, meta.chat_eval). Frozen: change it only deliberately, since scores before and after a change are not comparable.
rule: One approved Tier 3 batch, all of its dialogue-genre records. Chosen among the approved batches with dialogue records: every dialogue record splits into turns and aligns sentence by sentence with its English (16/16 under pie.export_chat.align_english), most are multi-turn (12 of 16 have 2-4 user turns), no assistant turn had a word 4-gram overlap >= 50% or a verbatim >= 2-word sentence in the rest of train at selection, and no coined token. t021 (40 records, 4-7 user turns) also qualifies, but reserving it would remove about half of the multi-turn training dialogue; b001/b004 are single-question riddles. When the Tier 3b chat batch t3b-001 is approved, a slice of it is the natural next reservation (the model as a character).
